ConflictBody.description: 409 — a ``block`` rule fired; repeat the write with ``override`` to keep it.
ConflictBody.title: ConflictBody

Corridor.description: A band a value is read against.
Corridor.title: Corridor

FeedRow.description:
One line of the day. ``text`` and ``detail`` are the owner's own words where
``kind`` is an event or a signal; for the rest the client writes them from
``kind`` and ``value``.
FeedRow.title: FeedRow

Goal.description: The first active weight goal, with where he started.
Goal.title: Goal

GoalForecast.description: Where the present trend meets the goal.
GoalForecast.title: GoalForecast

InvalidBody.description: 400 — a service refused the values (its ``ValueError`` message).
InvalidBody.title: InvalidBody

NavItem.description:
One section in the rail, in rail order. Its label is ``nav.<key>`` and its
rubric's is ``masthead.rubric.<rubric>``; both live in the i18n dictionaries.
NavItem.title: NavItem

NavSlot.description: One of the three middle columns of the phone's bottom bar.
NavSlot.title: NavSlot

NotFoundBody.description: 404 — the module behind the endpoint is switched off, or nothing is there.
NotFoundBody.title: NotFoundBody

RailStat.description:
One row of the rail's status card, as values — the client phrases them.
Only the fields of the row's own ``key`` are filled; the rest are null.
RailStat.title: RailStat

SyncStamp.description: An integration that last put something in the lake, and the day it did.
SyncStamp.title: SyncStamp

TodayFigure.description:
One of the key figures. Only the fields of its own ``key`` are filled; the rest
are null. ``value`` is null until there is a reading, and the row stays.
TodayFigure.title: TodayFigure

ViolationBody.description: One rule a write tripped — ``Violation.to_dict()`` of the conflict engine.
ViolationBody.title: ViolationBody

WeekChange.description:
A metric this week against last: the two seven-day values, on the corridor of
his own norm where there is one.
WeekChange.title: WeekChange

WeightLogPatch.description:
What to change; what is left out stays. ``note`` is the one field where an
explicit ``null`` means something: it clears the note.
WeightLogPatch.title: WeightLogPatch

WeightLogRef.description:
The row a write ended up on. Moving a reading to another day makes a new row,
so a patch answers with the id to use from then on.
WeightLogRef.title: WeightLogRef
